judgments.reason: The span 'FH: Global loss of expression' appears literally in the IHC findings and directly supports fumarate hydratase deficiency as the etiologic modifier, since loss of FH protein expression is a hallmark of FH-deficient tumors.

The span '2-SC: Absence of staining' appears literally in the IHC findings; absence of 2-succinocysteine (2-SC) staining is a recognized surrogate marker for fumarate hydratase deficiency, clinically supporting the FH-deficient modifier.

The span 'pathogenic variant in the FH gene (FHc.999C > A p.Cys333Ter)' appears literally in the genetic testing results and directly establishes the molecular basis for fumarate hydratase deficiency, supporting the etiologic modifier.
